purpose: Offline preparation for human bilingual review; not a benchmark score or a live evaluation harness.
offsetConvention: zero-based UTF-16 code units; end exclusive; exact unnormalized original sentence
limitations: All source sentences and meaning hints are AI-authored drafts, not independently reviewed ground truth.
Two or three candidates per source language are smoke-test coverage, not evidence of fluent quality or population accuracy.
Target glosses are nonexhaustive tentative hints, not exact-string assertions; distinct possible senses must remain separate.
Learner levels are requested test conditions, not validated CEFR labels for these sentences.
Pronunciation, audio, dialect suitability, learning outcomes, provider behavior, cost and latency have not been measured.
No personal data, external requests, API credentials, provider responses or paid-run code are included.
